about: Cues that are not in the table of kit/03-METHOD.md section 12. Addendum 001 added boss-loop and lets the Builder add up to audio.extraCuesMax more where a visible contact in the finished site has no sound. Each is also in audio.sfx and logged in kit/PROGRESS.md with its prompt. The ones the build added carry their length, their event and their class here until audio.sfx on main has their rows: pipeline/sound/NEEDS-sfx.patch.
